The full proposal

Hosting, handoff, monthly costs, ownership and the fine print, for when you want every detail.

How payment works

You never pay the full price up front. Every build is paid in stages that match the work done: 50% to start, 25% as the work takes shape, and the final 25% when it goes live. For the website, that’s a $197.50 deposit to begin, which is 50% of $395.

The Business System price may change based on scope, complexity, and the number of features.

Complete handoff: $40 CAD / month

Subject to change.

When the site is handed over to you, everything behind it stays hosted and kept running:

  • The website itself, online around the clock
  • The database that stores your consultation requests and enquiries
  • User logins, so you and your team can sign in securely
  • File storage for your photos and documents
  • Automated backups, so the site and your enquiries can be restored
  • Security, including the SSL certificate, the padlock visitors look for
  • Email sending for consultation notifications and confirmations

Self-service, the AI builder (you do it): The handoff also includes the AI-assisted builder. No code. You manage the site in natural language, in plain, everyday words, and update and manage it yourself easily. Each client gets their own builder, and access is handed over to you when the site is done. The builder is included in the $40 CAD a month, there is no separate charge for it. *Limited usage applies.

Some services may carry yearly or additional fees depending on what your site uses, for example payment processing, heavy AI usage, a premium SSL security certificate, yearly domain renewal, email hosting, extra storage or bandwidth, and map or review integrations. Those are charged by the provider and passed through at cost.

Services, Protiva does it for you (separate from the builder)

If you’d rather we run it: the management retainer, ask for a quote

Protiva can manage the site for you instead: hosting and care included, up to 4 content updates a month (text changes, photo swaps, new studio photos, seasonal tweaks), priority support, and a short monthly report on the site and its enquiries. Fixes, updates and new features, available for hire

If you need a fix, an update, or a new feature added, that work is available for hire. A few small tweaks, a typo, a phone number, a photo swap, are straightforward to request. Bigger work, like a new page or a new feature, is quoted up front before anything starts. Each job is quoted on its own. You approve the quote first, then the work begins.

Your domain and email

Adonis does not have a domain yet. We can register one for the studio in your name, at the registrar's yearly renewal, and point it at the new site. It stays registered in your name, at your registrar, under your control: you pay the registrar's yearly renewal and we handle the settings and reminders.

If you want email on your domain, we can set up mailboxes through Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 in your name, at the provider's per-mailbox rate. Keeping your current email works too.

Ownership

You own the site, the content, the files and the tech outright. At launch you get the logins, domain, hosting and site admin, all registered to Adonis Men's Medical Aesthetics Bar. If you ever move on, everything goes with you. Nothing is held hostage, and there’s no fee to leave.

Getting found: Google and AI answers

The site is set up to be found three ways. SEO (Search Engine Optimization): your pages carry the words clients actually search, and the site loads fast on phones. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization): your services, prices and reviews are stated clearly and structured so AI assistants can quote Adonis Men's Medical Aesthetics Bar when someone asks who does laser hair removal for men in Toronto. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): the same accurate facts are kept consistent across your site and profiles, so AI-generated summaries describe Adonis Men's Medical Aesthetics Bar correctly.

With the Business System ($2,999 $1,995): what’s behind it

  • The audit: before anything is built, we map how enquiries reach you today, website, phone, Instagram, inbox, and where enquiries get lost.
  • Implementation: the CRM is configured to how you run bookings: enquiry stages from new request to quoted to booked, the details you need on every booking, and automated follow-up sequences for enquiries who haven’t booked.
  • Your data: every enquiry lives in a database that belongs to Adonis Men's Medical Aesthetics Bar, backed up regularly and exportable to a spreadsheet any time you ask.
  • Analytics: see where each enquiry came from, how many consultation requests come in, and which turn into bookings.
  • Email notifications: every consultation request lands in your inbox, and the client gets an instant confirmation.
  • Training and handover: we walk you through the system, hand over a short written quick-start guide and every login, so you can run it yourself from day one.
  • Optional e-commerce add-on ($1,000): sell online with card payments on the site, plus automatic follow-ups for shoppers who start a purchase and leave.

To be clear on the numbers: the website ($599 $395), business system ($2,999 $1,995) and e-commerce prices are one-time, paid in the stages above. This promo pricing ends December 8, 2026. How do I book an appointment?

Use the online booking link to choose a service and appointment with Ahura. You can also contact the studio at 437-989-5290.

Where is the studio?

Find Adonis at 490 Queen St W (back door), Unit 302, Toronto, ON M5V 2B3.

Who will I see at my appointment?

Are evening appointments available?

The studio is open Monday–Thursday 3–10 PM, Friday 1–10 PM, and Saturday and Sunday 10 AM–11 PM. Check online booking for available appointments.
